Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased this grill and have not been happy with its performance.  The grill will not get hotter than 425 degrees. If you are looking for professional results DO NOT buy this grill.  It’s unfortunate because Weber does have a great history and presence in Chicago.  As a lifelong Chicagoan I would have liked to writ a better review.  Unfortunately, I am met with frustration every time I use this grill.

ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback. We can understand your frustration with the grill not reaching temperature. We are happy to help. 

It sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. Follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is also the way you would want to start your grill each and every time.

1. Open the lid
2. Make sure all knobs are in the off position (including side burner if applicable)
3. Turn your LP tank on all the way
4. Wait 30-60 seconds
5. Turn the first burner to start/high (first position to the left)
6. Hit your igniter
7. Turn on all remaining burners
8. Close the lid to preheat to 500-550°F

Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Thank you for your feedback. We are so sorry to hear you feel this way. 
 
The Flavorizer bars can develop surface corrosion due to their exposure to high heat and food drippings.

They don’t need to be replaced unless they have holes or cracks in them.
 
To clean your Flavorizer Bars, allow your grill to cool completely, then scrape the Flavorizer Bars with a plastic scraper.

We are happy to look into this further for you. Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Thank you!

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
